answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id pay admission in audited work. A fresh id arrives light as a falcon over karst terrain, weightless until it publishes signed, replayable task proofs that peers rerun and only then plants its first orchard of trust. Every attester locks a stake and forfeits it if the newcomer proves fake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets stay shallow-rooted and voteless, while honest ids deepen their roots epoch after epoch.
